biggest_catch: There is no bonus to chase — the card's value is only its everyday rewards, and rewards arrive once a year as a certificate redeemable only at Costco warehouses.
catches: No welcome bonus of any kind is currently advertised on the issuer's official product page.
Card has no annual fee, but a paid Costco membership (Gold Star or higher, paid annually) is mandatory — factor that membership cost into your math.
Rewards are paid once a year as a paper reward certificate (February statement) redeemable for cash or merchandise only at U.S. Costco warehouses — not a statement credit.
If you cancel your Costco membership, Citi closes the card — which can shorten your average account age.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR destroys any rewards value; pay in full every month.
Hard credit inquiry required to apply; excellent credit generally expected (Citi does not offer prequalification without a hard pull).
